description: Python code execution as a service for agents: send code, get stdout/stderr/exit code. Isolated (uid nobody, no persistence, hard limits: 10s CPU / 256MB / 64 procs). For agents that need to compute over data, not just read it. $0.01 USDC x402 Base. Input: {"code": "print(sum(range(100)))", "timeout_s": 10}. [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base; first 2 calls free]
name: code-sandbox
